source_title: Government Order (Ms) No. 50: Guidelines for Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
source_organization: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
evidence_locator: Section 3: Eligibility Norms and DBT Disbursement Protocol, Pages 2-6
evidence_excerpt: Eligible women heads of households will receive an entitlement grant of Rs 1,000 per month through direct bank transfer to acknowledge unpaid domestic labor.
evidence_interpretation: Direct primary documentary proof of scheme launch, statutory eligibility limits, and direct cash transfer mandate.
limitations: Specifies normative regulatory criteria; does not measure ground-level bank network outages or biometric rejection rates.

source_title: Tamil Nadu Budget Analysis 2025-26: Actuals of 2023-24
evidence_locator: Expenditure on Welfare Programs, Table 5, Page 8
evidence_excerpt: Actual expenditure under Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai for FY 2023-24 stood at Rs 7,995.12 crore, exceeding the initial Budget Estimate of Rs 7,000 crore.
evidence_interpretation: Reconciled fiscal accounting record verifying full disbursement of the enhanced allocation.
limitations: Represents treasury accounting totals; individual bank statement reconciliations are outside the scope of annual state budget papers.

source_title: Government Order (Ms) No. 42: Implementation of Pudhumai Penn Higher Education Assurance Scheme
source_organization: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
evidence_excerpt: All girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in government schools shall receive Rs 1,000 per month till completion of undergraduate degree or diploma course.
evidence_interpretation: Statutory executive enactment guaranteeing higher education entitlement to public school female alumni.
limitations: Does not record post-college formal employment absorption or initial private college resistance.

source_title: Health and Family Welfare Department Press Release: 1-Crore Beneficiaries Milestone under Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam
source_organization: Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Government of Tamil Nadu
evidence_excerpt: The Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam scheme has achieved the historic milestone of screening and treating 1,00,00,000 unique beneficiaries at their doorsteps.
evidence_interpretation: Administrative service delivery bulletin recording verified physical doorstep coverage.
limitations: Self-reported administrative progress figure; independent sample validation required for continuous medication adherence.

source_title: State Planning Commission Evaluation Report: Morning Nutrition and School Attendance Impacts
evidence_locator: Chapter IV: Attendance Trajectory Analysis, Pages 32-38
evidence_excerpt: Pilot schools registered average daily attendance increase of 8.4 percentage points, rising from 78.5% in 2021-22 to 86.9% in the post-launch evaluation window.
evidence_interpretation: Independent empirical evidence of nutritional intervention driving educational attendance.
limitations: Evaluated pilot phase primarily; long-term academic test score trajectories were not tracked in this wave.

source_title: Tamil Nadu Municipal Solid Waste Annual Performance Statistics (2020-2024)
source_organization: Directorate of Municipal Administration / Greater Chennai Corporation
evidence_locator: Table 1: Daily Waste Generation, Processing and Landfill Diversion, Page 4
evidence_excerpt: Total daily solid waste generation in GCC reached 1,150 TPD in CY 2024, of which 450 TPD was processed/recycled, yielding a recovery rate of 39.13%.
evidence_interpretation: Administrative operational dataset reflecting waste collection and biomining efficiency.
limitations: Shows processing progress from 36.84% (2020) to 39.13% (2024), but documents failure to achieve the 50% target.

source_title: Report of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India on Local Bodies (Government of Tamil Nadu)
source_organization: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
evidence_excerpt: Audit observed that source segregation remained below 55% in southern zones and processing plants operated below rated capacity, resulting in continued dumping at legacy dumpsites.
evidence_interpretation: Statutory audit finding qualifying official municipal claims of complete scientific processing.
limitations: Covers audit sample years 2020-2022; later expansions in 2023-2024 are covered by subsequent audit cycles.
